items.title: Japan core inflation in September surges to its highest this year at 2.1%
items.sum: Core inflation, which strips out prices of fresh food, was in line with the 2.1% forecast by economists polled by Reuters.

items.title: UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations
items.sum: U.K. inflation rose by a hotter-than-expected 3.5% in the 12 months to September, driven by the surging cost of motor fuels.
